payload.core_mechanism_summary: Precompute Stirling numbers of the second kind S(n, i) using a 2D DP recurrence optimized to 1D array, then combine with factorials and powers to count colorings satisfying vertical balance condition.
payload.rationale: The solution uses dynamic programming with state (n, i) for Stirling numbers, a classic 2D DP, to efficiently compute counts for the combinatorial summation.
